description:
"Conjure a ball of solar energy to heave at an enemy, dealing |cffffff8635|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage done with class abilities by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Afflicts the target and enemies within |cffffff8|r meters with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.
 
Also grants you Empower for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff70|r%."
